dialogues.speaker: Medyntsev
dialogues.text: Funding is secured, the plan is solid, and the market research is complete... yes, this time it's going to work!

dialogues.speaker: Medyntsev
dialogues.text: The plan to make a fortune! Friend, do you know what sells best in Snezhnaya? That's right — alcohol! Especially strong liquor!

dialogues.speaker: Medyntsev
dialogues.text: I've thought it through: if I buy large quantities of Mondstadt wine, ship it to Snezhnaya, and then refine it further until it's as strong as Fire-Water itself... it'll absolutely sell like crazy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...But why not just sell Fire-Water directly?

dialogues.speaker: Medyntsev
dialogues.text: You're right! I should ship Fire-Water to Mondstadt instead! Just dilute it a little, pass it off as low-alcohol wine, and sell it there... That's way smarter and more profitable!

dialogues.speaker: Medyntsev
dialogues.text: By then, my father will finally recognize my business genius, and the family company will be mine! Hahaha!
